description:
Read the node tree of a scene: names, types and paths. Pass scenePath for an exact scene and depth for deep trees; the engine stops at depth 2 and 200 nodes by default and says truncated. Next: summer_inspect_node.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/get-scene-tree"}

depth.description: Maximum tree depth to walk. Engine default is 2 — pass a larger value for deep hierarchies.

limit.description: Maximum number of nodes to return. Engine default is 200.

maxCharacters.description: Most characters of text to return (default 8000). A longer result is cut and says so.

scenePath.description: Exact res:// scene path to inspect

name: summer_get_scene_tree
title: Read a scene's node tree
